attempts.summary: Configured NFS export of /srv/nfs/shared on node1 mounted at /mnt/shared on node2, using a shared dataops (UID/GID 4500) identity on both nodes and directory ownership dataops:dataops with mode 2770. Verified cross-node write consistency, then restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, confirming changed boot IDs and full recovery of the NFS export/mount and correct ownership/permissions afterward.
